records.context: A shared or community row is spaCR's when it is the very file a bundled record names (structured-data name and checksum) or when it is fetched from one of the maintainer's own repositories (:func:`is_spacr_owned`). Anything else uploaded by somebody else stays under ``spaCR community``.

records.source: A shared or community row is spaCR's when it is the very file a bundled record names (key and checksum) or when it is fetched from one of the maintainer's own repositories (:func:`is_spacr_owned`). Anything else uploaded by somebody else stays under ``spaCR community``.
records.translation: 共享行或社区行在以下情况下归入 spaCR：它正是某条内置记录所指定的文件（键和校验和一致），或它从维护者自己的某个仓库获取（:func:`is_spacr_owned`）。其他人上传的其余内容仍归入 ``spaCR community``。
